path.description: File, absolute or relative to the workspace root.

name.description: The symbol's name; looked up on the line and up to 3 lines either side.

occurrence.description: Which match of name on the line (default 1).

column.description: 1-based column in characters, when name is not given.

qualified.description: Instead of path and line: the symbol's qualified name, such as std.mem.Allocator, found by a workspace symbol search.

direction.description: incoming: who calls it; outgoing: what it calls (default incoming).
